newsitem.title: USA: Head of Milligan brokerage arrested for bribes - NYT.
newsitem.headline: Head of Milligan brokerage arrested for bribes - NYT.

text.p: Federal officials have arrested the head of a small Manhattan stock brokerage company on charges that he accepted a $100,000 bribe to sell worthless stock to customers, the New York Times said on Wednesday.
The report said Philip John Milligan, the head of J.P. Milligan, is accused of taking the bribe to get his customers to buy stock in Pilot Transport, a Utah company.
It said customers bought about 19,000 shares of the stock for $12 each from November 1995 through February 1996, and that the last trade for the stock in December was for one-tenth of a penny.
